crossRefs.note: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.
Don’t trust in a neighbor. Don’t put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in your embrace, be careful of the…
For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her…
When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”

translations.web: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.
translations.bsb: For even His own brothers did not believe in Him.
translations.kjv: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
translations.asv: For even his brethren did not believe on him.
